title: 埃默里大学专家：病毒传播方式令人关注，密切接触是关键
speaker: Dr. Carlos Del Rio

segments.en: No, it actually does. This Andy's antivirus is the only one that's pressed person to person. And there was an outbreak in Argentina in 2018, 2019, where some of the things that you were mentioning actually happened.
segments.zh: 不，实际上确实存在。这种病毒是唯一一种通过人际传播的。2018至2019年阿根廷的疫情中，就出现了你提到的类似情况。

segments.en: Some person just got infected because they were in the same room with another person that was infected or they were in the same bathroom. It is very clear that if you have very close intimate contact, for example, in this case, the index case, then his wife got infected, they were in the same cabin.
segments.zh: 有人仅仅因为与感染者同处一室或共用卫生间就感染了。很明显，如果存在非常密切的接触，比如这起事件中的首发病例，他的妻子在同一船舱内就感染了。

segments.en: They could have been intimate sexually. There's a lot of reasons why the wife got infected so quickly and then developed symptoms, but that doesn't mean it's an all or non phenomena.
segments.zh: 他们可能有性接触。妻子快速感染并出现症状的原因很多，但这并非绝对现象。

segments.en: Clearly, there's a lot of things about the transmission we don't fully understand. And I think this outbreak is going to help us right to understand that it is very clear that the closer you are, the more intimate contact, the more likely you are to get infected.
segments.zh: 显然，关于传播我们还有很多未知。这次疫情将帮助我们理解：接触越近、越亲密，感染可能性越大。

segments.en: But that doesn't mean that we have not seen what appears to be fairly casual mechanisms of infection.
segments.zh: 但这并不意味着我们没有观察到看似相当随意的感染机制。
